title: Anna Bond
desc: Bond Ravi, a martial arts champion, and Meera, a documentary film-maker, fall in love with each other. However, she gets kidnapped by a drug lord, prompting Bond to spring into action.

title: Chandu
desc: Chandu, a college student, beats up a gangster for his unjust acts. Fearing the wrath of the gangster, his parents send him to Bengaluru, where he meets the love of his life.

title: F2: Fun and Frustration
desc: Two young men hope to control their wives after their respective marriages. However, their chauvinistic attitude often lands them in hilarious situations.

title: Seetharamam
desc: Afreen, a Pakistani woman, heads to India in order to deliver a love letter written in 1965 to fulfill her grandfather's dying wish. However, the journey alters her life forever.

title: Gaja
desc: A cat and mouse chase ensues between Gaja and a rival faction leader over a few startling events. Gaja tries to protect his friend, Krishna, and his lover, Shwetha, who are being targeted.
